title: Geometry-noise floor calibration before any B4 movement cell
purpose: Estimate a conservative, instrument-conditional threshold from frozen static cache replays, separate geometry from raster kernels, then require a separately authorized single-cell preflight. This is not a grid or production test.

prior_b3.verdict: preflight numeric cutoff failed; full corrected-gate grid was not tested
prior_b3.interpretation: The same diagnostic cell's post-reanchor excursion fell about 44.96x after resetting trajectory state into the new anchor frame, supporting the named harness fix. B3 passed the cell invariants but failed only its frozen <=1 px numeric cutoff, by 0.993 px. This is not evidence against the full-flow motion-gate hypothesis: the corrected full grid was not tested. The cross-round comparison does not establish the residual source.

runner.fail_closed: The runner must reject draft/false authorization, mismatched hashes/fingerprint, missing cache entries, repeated outputs, incomplete blocks, failed N0, failed holdout, T >= 3 page-grid px, and any request to sweep/confirm without separate authorization.

questions.N0_numeric_identity: Do identical corners with zero detector noise and an exact no-op reset produce excursion <= 0.001 page px?
questions.NG_static_geometry: What are the ordinary and post-no-op distributions of the actual post-tracker/median corner stream while the true page quad stays fixed?
questions.NR_rasterization: With inputs/corners/matrices held fixed, how do render and registration kernels separately affect raster-space metrics? They must not affect the corner excursion.

measurement_contract.coordinate_system: Canonical page-grid pixels; never camera px, homography coefficients, ink centroid error, or the F-07 candidate envelope.
measurement_contract.formula: P = page_matrix(anchor, page_shape); e[t] = max_i norm(perspectiveTransform(corners[t,i], P) - anchor_points[i]).
measurement_contract.implementation_source: V3 MotionGate._trajectory; depends only on anchor, page shape, corners and anchor_points, not the probability raster or its interpolation kernel.
measurement_contract.rounding: Store full precision; calculate T before display rounding.
measurement_contract.distinction: GEOMETRY_TOL_PX=5 is an ink-following metric, the B3 instrument cutoff was 1, the historical candidate grid was 1/2/4, and 3 px is only the predeclared resolution target in this B4 draft. They are not interchangeable.

inputs.source: Existing real-negative warp set and matching probability cache only; trajectories/noise are synthetic, not recorded webcam video.
inputs.cache_requirement_per_phase: 30 hits, 0 misses; verify model, warp, index, and blob hashes before loading; do not invoke ONNX or synthetic fallback.
inputs.static_fixture: Existing real cached f01-f30 maps, with fixed true page quad Q; f28-f30 are the predeclared raster diagnostic maps.
inputs.hand_profile: presente_mexendo (hand-present/active sampling signal), while true page geometry remains static.
inputs.external_validity: T applies only to this frozen simulated corner provider, detector-noise model, tracker/median, page shape and cadence. It is not a measured webcam floor or an automatic threshold for other hand/rest strata.

sampling.unit: One independent PCG64 detector-noise seed block; passes within a block are dependent and are not counted as independent samples.
sampling.block_seed: SeedSequence([20261107, 4, phase_id, block_id]); phase_id=0 N0, 1 calibration, 2 held-out validation, 3 reserved future preflight block 0.
state_per_geometry_block: Restore the same hashed static real-cache base and fixed true quad Q.
Warm up the original tracker/median for 32 effective passes.
Record 64 effective passes, all corners, pass indices, simulation time and state provenance.
After measuring pass 32, perform one instrumental no-op reset on a shadow copy only; do not alter the app, canvas, gate decision, confirmed map, votes, or generation.
If 64 effective passes are not delivered within 6000 simulated frames, mark the block incomplete and stop the phase; never backfill or discard it.

strata.ordinary: Per-block max(e[1:32]) against the fixed pre-reset anchor.
strata.post_noop: Per-block max(e[33:64]) after the shadow reset; report e[33] separately as the immediately-next-pass diagnostic.

sampling.vacuity: No pass admitted by the frozen corner provider means incomplete/inconclusive, not a fabricated observation. Other hand/rest profiles are not inferred from this active-signal stratum.

N0.fixture: Exact identical corners for every pass and exact identity no-op reset.
N0.decision: Any value above 0.001 px or missing evidence stops the calibration; do not relax this numeric sanity check from observed results.

threshold.calibration_statistic: Z[b,s] is the maximum excursion within independent noise block b and stratum s.
threshold.freeze_rule: T = nextafter(max(Z[b,s] over all 512 calibration blocks and both strata), +infinity).
threshold.coverage_claim: If the 512 seed blocks are independent and representative under the frozen simulator, the maximum is an upper tolerance bound for the p99 block-max in each stratum with simultaneous coverage >= 1 - 2*(0.99**512) = 0.9883520464626726, by union bound/order-statistic argument. This is conditional to the simulator, not a real-camera guarantee.
threshold.report_only_quantiles: Nearest-rank ceil(p*n) for p50/p90/p95/p99 of per-pass excursions and block maxima, by stratum; these descriptive quantiles do not replace the frozen T rule.
threshold.resolution_stop: If T >= 3 page-grid px, instrument resolution is insufficient for a 3 px target; stop. Do not widen the algorithm envelope or select a different metric.

held_out_validation.binary_rule: For each of ordinary and post_noop, nearest-rank q99 of the 512 held-out block maxima must be <= the previously frozen T.
held_out_validation.report: Counts and fractions of block maxima above T, empirical quantiles and interval/uncertainty by block and stratum.
held_out_validation.failure: Incomplete blocks, failed N0, missing hashes, or either stratum q99 > T fails/inconclusive; no recalculating T from validation or adding seeds.

raster_decomposition.blocks: The first 8 calibration blocks only, selected before execution.
raster_decomposition.controls: Pair exact same page maps, corners, anchor matrices, timestamps, visibility mask and identity fast path across all arms. Record when no interpolation actually occurs.
raster_decomposition.interpretation: Raster metrics are distinct from corner excursion. Any excursion difference with exactly fixed geometry is an instrumentation defect. Do not choose a kernel or use raster metrics to fit T.

future_H1_preflight.cell: translate_small / presente_parada / Config(1,3,0.8), no probe, phase_id=3 block_id=0.
future_H1_preflight.only_new_cutoff: Immediate next classified-pass geometric excursion <= frozen T; do not change MotionGate's 1 px envelope, persistence ratio, window, or timeout.
future_H1_preflight.comparability: The true page quad must be static from reanchor through next classified pass and the corner-provider shape/cadence/profile must match the frozen calibration contract. Otherwise mark non-comparable/inconclusive; never choose a later pass.
other_frozen_invariants: zero confirmed pixel additions/losses outside tolerance
future_H1_preflight.outcome: Failure stops. Success opens no grid, confirmation, or production change; those need separate complete preregistration and approval.

grid_and_scope.three_px_status: Resolution target only, not a registered candidate. Including a 3 px algorithm envelope requires a new explicit grid specification before execution.
grid_and_scope.H2: Any unresolved timeout in a natural active control remains an independent B4 failure/incomplete-hypothesis signal. Shadow no-op resets and static calibration cannot resolve control availability.
grid_and_scope.production: Untouched; no changes to draw/ink_layers.py or the production gate.
grid_and_scope.F11: drop_and_return_same_page identity (16/24) remains separate and stopped; do not run or use it.
grid_and_scope.outputs: Only the explicitly authorized phase may write its named V4 artifact; never overwrite V1-V3.
